newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Anicom Inc started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Anicom Inc started.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Andrew Jeffrey has started coverage of shares of Anicom Inc with a long-term attractive rating.
-- Anicom distributes communication and security-related wire, cable, fiber optics, computer network and connectivity products.
-- In a statement, Jeffrey called Anicom a "pure-play distribution story" that is "among the largest specialized competitors in this market."
-- Jeffrey estimates the company will earn $0.20 a share in 1996 and $0.29 a share in 1997.
-- Shares were trading unchanged at 9-3/4 in late morning exchange trade.
